metadata.description: Internal Claude Code plugins for OhMyHotel engineering — git workflow, PR automation, release management, and SLA/incident management following the company Git Branch Strategy and SLA Policy.

plugins.name: omh-git-workflow
plugins.description: 22 slash commands that automate the OMH git branch strategy: new-branch, new-worktree, commit, squash, open-pr, open-pr-to, check-pr, fix-pr, ci-status, reviewers, release, cherry-pick, reset-develop, reset-staging, sync-local, sync-master, hotfix, rollback, delete-branch, clean-worktree, voc-migration, status.

plugins.name: omh-sla-workflow
plugins.description: 5 slash commands that enforce the OMH SLA Policy for incident management and Post-Incident Reviews: incident-triage, create-pir, review-pir, pir-action-items, sla-report.
